instruction.name: movcf2gr
instruction.description: Move condition code cj into rd.

latencies.notes: movcf2gr+movgr2cf round trip is 22 cycles; fcmp+movcf2gr+movgr2fr is 11 cycles with fcmp=1 and movgr2fr=1, giving movcf2gr=9 and movgr2cf=13. Unroll 10000, iters 1000. Raw measurement was 9.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: movcf2gr $r12, $fcc0; movcf2gr $r13, $fcc1; movcf2gr $r14, $fcc2; movcf2gr $r15, $fcc3; movcf2gr $r16, $fcc4; movcf2gr $r17, $fcc5; movcf2gr $r18, $fcc6; movcf2gr $r19, $fcc7
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 0; movgr2cf $fcc0, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc1, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc2, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc3, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc4, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc5, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc6, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc7, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0; movgr2cf $fcc0, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc1, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc2, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc3, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc4, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc5, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc6, $r4; movgr2cf $fcc7, $r4' --asm 'movcf2gr $r12, $fcc0; movcf2gr $r13, $fcc1; movcf2gr $r14, $fcc2; movcf2gr $r15, $fcc3; movcf2gr $r16, $fcc4; movcf2gr $r17, $fcc5; movcf2gr $r18, $fcc6; movcf2gr $r19, $fcc7'

notes: Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
